description: Run a tool from node_modules/.bin, fetching it from the registry on a local miss (a faster npx / pnpm dlx).

next.name: auto
tip: Use color only when output is a TTY.

option.name: --cpu
tip: CPU architecture(s) to install optional dependencies for.

option.name: --fail-if-no-match
tip: Error if the filter selects zero packages.

option.name: --filter
tip: Filter workspace packages by name or glob.

option.name: --ignore-existing
tip: Removed from npm v9+; nubx warns and ignores it.

option.name: --include-workspace-root
tip: Add the workspace root package to the recursive set (npm-style).
Distinct from --workspace-root, which targets only the root.

option.name: --libc
tip: C library/libraries to install optional dependencies for.

next.name: glibc
tip: GNU C Library, used by most Linux distributions.

option.name: --minimum-release-age
tip: How old a version must be before it can be installed: a duration with a unit (30s, 5m, 2h, 3d, 1w), or a bare number meaning minutes.
0 turns the age gate off for this run.
Turn the age gate off for this run.

next.name: 1d
tip: Only install versions at least one day old.

next.name: 1h
tip: Only install versions at least one hour old.

next.name: 1w
tip: Only install versions at least one week old.

option.name: --minimum-release-age-exclude
tip: Exempt packages from the age gate for this run.
A bare name, a * name glob, or a name with a version range.
Replaces any configured minimumReleaseAgeExclude rather than adding to it.

option.name: --no
tip: Alias of --no-install: refuse to fetch a missing tool (npx --no).

option.name: --no-check
tip: Skip the pre-run dependency-freshness check for this invocation.

option.name: --no-install
tip: Never fetch: if the tool isn't installed locally, error instead of fetching it (npx --no-install).

option.name: --node
tip: Disable Nub's runtime augmentation for this invocation.

option.name: --os
tip: Operating system(s) to install optional dependencies for.

option.name: --package
tip: Fetch package SPEC and run a bin from it (the bin name may differ from the package).

option.name: --parallel
tip: Run the bin in all packages concurrently with no topological ordering.

option.name: --workspace-concurrency
tip: Max concurrent packages per topological chunk.

option.name: --workspace-root
tip: Run from the workspace root regardless of cwd.

option.name: --workspaces
tip: Run the bin in every workspace package.

option.name: --yes
tip: Consent up-front to the implicit registry fetch (npx -y): skips the first-fetch prompt.
The escape hatch out of the CI / non-TTY fail-closed default.
